subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google presents Vertex AI as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but the issue’s proposed wording differs from Google’s current public wording and a provider-id rename would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels and docs to bridge the new Google name with the existing Vertex/provider identity while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the existing label until maintainers decide that Google’s rebrand has settled enough for OpenClaw UI/docs.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter’s shorter wording, accepting that it does not match the official Google Cloud wording checked during review.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels and docs to bridge the new Google name with the existing Vertex/provider identity while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable id.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent ownership and product-decision signal around Google provider setup/copy surfaces.
